title: ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
abstract: arXiv:2610.21042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. translated_title: ReviewPilot：用于系统综述筛选与数据提取的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 系统性文献综述遵循PRISMA流程，即筛选学术文献并从纳入的研究中提取证据。基于大语言模型（LLM）的深度研究工具能够搜索和总结文献，但不会记录哪些研究被排除，也不会标注提取数值的来源。我们开发了一个名为ReviewPilot的对话式多智能体系统，将PRISMA工作流从论文筛选到信息提取实现自动化。研究人员可以通过对话定制筛选标准和提取模式，项目记忆会保存其配置和修订记录。每项筛选决定都附有理由，每个提取值都标明来源。在流行病学专家综述上，ReviewPilot在三种大语言模型上的表现均优于单提示词LLM和AgentSLR，筛选宏观F1最高达0.776，提取F1最高达0.788。在生物医学和人机交互领域的案例研究中，其结果与人类标注者高度一致。
tldr: 提出对话式多智能体系统ReviewPilot，通过可对话定制的标准与全程可追溯的决策来源实现PRISMA筛选与数据提取流程自动化，在流行病学专家综述上显著优于单提示词LLM和AgentSLR等方法。
en_tdlr: ReviewPilot is a conversational multi-agent system that automates the PRISMA screening and data extraction workflow with dialogue-customizable criteria and fully traceable decisions and provenance, outperforming single-prompt LLMs and AgentSLR on epidemiological expert reviews.
